intro: Maltese culture blends Arab, Italian and British influences, from village festas to colourful fishing boats.

chapters.title: Boats and balconies
text: Brightly painted fishing boats called luzzu carry an eye on the bow, an ancient symbol of protection. Valletta's streets are lined with enclosed wooden balconies in bright colours.

chapters.title: Food
text: Pastizzi (flaky pastries with ricotta or peas), rabbit stew and ftira bread, on UNESCO's heritage list, are favourites.

keyTerms.meaning: A traditional, colourfully painted Maltese fishing boat.
